description: Official Replicate API schema for prunaai/p-video

fps.description: Frames per second of the video.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed. Leave blank for random.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: Optional. Input audio to condition video generation. Supports flac, mp3, wav.

draft.title: Draft
draft.description: Draft mode. Generates a lower-quality preview of the video.

image.title: Image
image.description: Optional. Input image to generate video from (image-to-video). Supports jpg, jpeg, png, webp.

no_op.title: No Op
no_op.description: Health check mode - returns status without inference.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the video in seconds (1-20). Ignored when audio is provided.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the video. Ignored when an input image is provided.

last_frame_image.title: Last Frame Image
last_frame_image.description: Optional. Reference image for the last frame of the video. Supports jpg, jpeg, png, webp.

prompt_upsampling.title: Prompt Upsampling
prompt_upsampling.description: Use prompt upsampling to enhance the prompt.

disable_safety_filter.title: Disable Safety Filter
disable_safety_filter.description: Disable safety filter for prompts (and input image). When disabled, prompts are not checked for unsafe content before generation.

title: p-video Input Schema
